{{Quote|Tatooine isn't exactly known for having hospitable climate, but if you still want to vacation here, you should probably stay away from the Badlands.|[[Dax Gazaway]]|<ref name="Star Wars: Racer Revenge">''[[Star Wars: Racer Revenge]]''</ref>}}
The '''Badlands''' was a [[Podracing/Legends|podracing]] track on [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]]. The terrain was very hazardous for podracers. The track favorite as of [[24 BBY/Legends|24 BBY]] was [[Gasgano/Legends|Gasgano]].

The course put the racers in a path with dangerous obstacles, such as a [[Sandcrawler/Legends|sandcrawler]], several [[Moisture vaporator/Legends|vaporators]], and large rocks. The steep dropoff usually resulted in podracer combat. The sharp turns made smooth navigation difficult.
